description.narrative:
The project is implemented by the Palestinian Agricultural Cooperative Union (PACU), the national umbrella body representing 112 agricultural cooperatives across the West Bank and Gaza. It aims to strengthen PACU's institutional capacity, governance, and financial sustainability to enhance its ability to serve and represent cooperative members effectively. By the end of 2026, PACU will have improved its internal systems, policies, and strategic direction to operate as a transparent, inclusive, and sustainable cooperative union. The organisation will be better equipped to coordinate with government and civil society stakeholders, advocate for the cooperative sector, and provide tailored services to its member cooperatives. Expected results include: (1) an updated Strategic Plan and Fundraising Strategy; (2) revised governance and financial management manuals; (3) increased capacity of board and staff members on leadership, gender equality, and resource mobilisation; and (4) improved communication and coordination mechanisms with members and partners. Key activities include institutional assessments, policy and strategy development, board and staff capacity-building workshops, and stakeholder engagement.
The project contributes to the We Effect CSO Programme Together for Food Security in Palestine (2025-2028) as a time-bound institutional strengthening and exit-phase initiative, ensuring that PACU remains a functional and representative actor within the cooperative movement.
